\subsection{Category 1: arrival of discretion}
\paragraph{SB 35} \textit{SB 35 (Wiener), Stats. 2017, ch. 366; effective 2018-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``SB 35, Wiener. Planning and zoning: affordable housing: streamlined approval process.'' --- ``subject to a requirement mandating a minimum percentage of below market rate housing based on one of the following''.
\emph{Treated set.} Projects that file under it: the Planning records' SB 35 flag, and the text. Eligibility (affordability, labour standards, site exclusions) is not constructible. SB 35 flag + text: 13 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Applications filed under the pathway, by quarter; approval within the statutory window without a hearing. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Share of eligible-looking projects that choose it; time to permit. \emph{Unobserved.} Eligibility, and the labour and affordability commitments. \emph{Confounds.} An opt-in pathway bundled with labour and affordability conditions; SB 423 changed it in 2024. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\paragraph{SB 423} \textit{SB 423 (Wiener), Stats. 2023, ch. 778; effective 2024-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``SB 423, Wiener. Land use: streamlined housing approvals: multifamily housing developments.''.
\emph{Treated set.} As SB 35; the records have no SB 423 field, only the text. SB 423 in text: 7 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As SB 35. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} As SB 35. \emph{Unobserved.} As SB 35. \emph{Confounds.} Housing Element rezoning, the 2024 Housing Production ordinance. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\paragraph{AB 2011} \textit{AB 2011 (Wicks), Stats. 2022, ch. 647; effective 2023-01-01; opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``AB 2011, Wicks. Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act of 2022.'' --- ``use by right and subject to one of 2 streamlined, ministerial review processes''.
\emph{Treated set.} Commercial-zone housing projects electing it; site, corridor and labour criteria are not constructible; found by text. AB 2011 in text: 5 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Applications under it, by quarter. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Housing on commercial parcels. \emph{Unobserved.} Eligibility. \emph{Confounds.} SB 6 (same year), AB 2243 (2024). \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\paragraph{SB 4} \textit{SB 4 (Wiener), Stats. 2023, ch. 771; effective 2024-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``SB 4, Wiener. Planning and zoning: housing development: higher education institutions and religious institutions.'' --- ``use by right upon the request of an applicant who submits an application for streamlined approval, on any land owned by an independent institution of higher education or religious institution''.
\emph{Treated set.} Projects on such land; ownership is not in the data. SB 4 in text: 0 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} --- \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} Ownership, election. \emph{Confounds.} --- \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{AB 2243} \textit{AB 2243 (Wicks), Stats. 2024, ch. 272; effective 2025-01-01; opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``AB 2243, Wicks. Housing development projects: objective standards: affordability and site criteria.''.
\emph{Treated set.} As AB 2011.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As AB 2011. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} As AB 2011. \emph{Confounds.} An amendment; no separate variation. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{Family Housing Opportunity SUD} \textit{Ord. 195-23 (File 230026); effective 2023-10-16; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``create the Family Housing Opportunity Special Use District''.
\emph{Treated set.} RH parcels in the SUD (a zoning-panel join); eligibility conditions partly constructible. FHO SUD in text: 2 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Discretionary reviews and CUs for RH projects in the SUD, by quarter. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Multi-unit filings in RH districts. \emph{Unobserved.} Eligibility details. \emph{Confounds.} The 2024 Housing Production ordinance. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\paragraph{Housing Production (Ord. 248-23)} \textit{Ord. 248-23 (File 230446); effective 2024-01-14; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``exempting, under certain conditions, specified housing projects from the notice and review procedures of Section 311 and the Conditional Use requirement of Section 317''.
\emph{Treated set.} Residential items on the docket; the Priority Equity Geographies SUD is a polygon not yet joined. residential CU items: 99 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Residential CU and DR items per quarter, before and after. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Filings of the exempted project types. \emph{Unobserved.} Which projects the exemptions reached. \emph{Confounds.} Ord. 53-24 four months later; the Housing Element. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{usable}.
\paragraph{Housing Production (Ord. 53-24)} \textit{Ord. 53-24 (File 231258); effective 2024-04-22; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``exempting, under certain conditions, specified housing projects from the notice and review procedures of Section 311''.
\emph{Treated set.} As 248-23. residential CU items: 99 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As 248-23. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} As 248-23. \emph{Unobserved.} As 248-23. \emph{Confounds.} 248-23. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{usable}.
\paragraph{Minimum densities (Ord. 292-24)} \textit{Ord. 292-24 (File 230596); effective 2025-01-19; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``require oonditional use authorization for residential housing developments that do not maximize minimum residential density''.
\emph{Treated set.} Projects in RM/RC/RTO below minimum density (zoning panel and unit counts).
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} CUs for under-density projects. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Unit counts. \emph{Unobserved.} The minimum density per parcel. \emph{Confounds.} The Family Zoning Plan. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\subsection{Category 2: delay given discretion}
\paragraph{Permit Streamlining Act} \textit{Gov. Code 65920 et seq. (time limits: 65950); effective not established; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``shall approve or disapprove the project within whichever of the following periods is applicable''.
\emph{Treated set.} All development projects; the clock runs from the lead agency's CEQA document or completeness determination, neither of which is in the data.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Days from CEQA certification (or exemption) to approval, capped by the statute; the start date is not recorded. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} The CEQA completion and completeness dates. \emph{Confounds.} --- \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{Housing Accountability Act} \textit{Gov. Code 65589.5; effective not established; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``This section shall be known, and may be cited, as the Housing Accountability Act''.
\emph{Treated set.} Housing projects consistent with objective standards; consistency is not a field.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Disapprovals or density reductions of compliant projects; the docket records disapprovals but not compliance. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Filing of projects that rely on it. \emph{Unobserved.} Compliance with objective standards. \emph{Confounds.} Amended repeatedly (SB 167, AB 678, AB 1515, SB 330, AB 1633). \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{SB 167 (HAA)} \textit{SB 167 (Skinner), Stats. 2017, ch. 368; effective 2018-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``SB 167, Skinner. Housing Accountability Act.'' --- ``This bill would require the findings of the local agency to instead be based on a preponderance of the evidence in the record''.
\emph{Treated set.} As the HAA.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As the HAA. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} As the HAA. \emph{Confounds.} Enacted with AB 678 and AB 1515. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{AB 678 (HAA)} \textit{AB 678 (Bocanegra), Stats. 2017, ch. 373; effective 2018-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``AB 678, Bocanegra. Housing Accountability Act.''.
\emph{Treated set.} As the HAA.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As the HAA. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} As the HAA. \emph{Confounds.} Enacted with SB 167 and AB 1515. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{AB 1515 (HAA)} \textit{AB 1515 (Daly), Stats. 2017, ch. 378; effective 2018-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``AB 1515, Daly. Planning and zoning: housing.''.
\emph{Treated set.} As the HAA.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As the HAA. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} As the HAA. \emph{Confounds.} Enacted with SB 167 and AB 678. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{AB 1633} \textit{AB 1633 (Ting), Stats. 2023, ch. 768; effective 2024-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``AB 1633, Ting. Housing Accountability Act: disapprovals: California Environmental Quality Act.'' --- ``fails to make a determination of whether the project is exempt from CEQA or commits an abuse of discretion''.
\emph{Treated set.} As the HAA.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} CEQA delay on compliant projects; CEQA dates are not recorded. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} CEQA dates. \emph{Confounds.} --- \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{AB 130 (2025 budget trailer: housing)} \textit{AB 130 (Committee on Budget), Stats. 2025, ch. 22; effective 2025-06-30; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``AB 130, Committee on Budget. Housing.'' --- ``this division does not apply to any aspect of a housing development project''.
\emph{Treated set.} Infill projects exempt from CEQA under it; the exemption is not a field.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} CEQA document type on PRJ records. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} Eligibility. \emph{Confounds.} SB 131 (same day); too recent. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{SB 131 (2025 budget trailer: CEQA)} \textit{SB 131 (Committee on Budget and Fiscal Review), Stats. 2025, ch. 24; effective 2025-06-30; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``SB 131, Committee on Budget and Fiscal Review. Public Resources.'' --- ``This division does not apply to a rezoning that implements the schedule of actions contained in an approved housing element''.
\emph{Treated set.} As specified; not a field.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} --- \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} --- \emph{Confounds.} AB 130; too recent. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{Site-permit streamlining (Ord. 154-23)} \textit{Ord. 154-23 (File 230374); effective 2023-08-28; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``define and limit the scope of Building Official review of site permits''.
\emph{Treated set.} Site permits (DBI's site-permit flag).
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Days from filing to issuance of site permits, before and after. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} --- \emph{Confounds.} DBI staffing, the permit backlog. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\paragraph{CU appeals (Ord. 191-22)} \textit{Ord. 191-22 (File 220130); effective 2022-10-17; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}

\subsection{Category 3: stringency in dollars}
\paragraph{Proposition C and Ord. 76-16} \textit{Ord. 76-16 (File 160255); effective 2016-06-12; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``will become effective only on the effective date of the 16 Charter amendment revising Section 16.110 at the June 7, 2016 election''.
\emph{Treated set.} Every project of ten or more units: the exaction panel.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} The vested inclusionary share (the exaction panel). \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Filing around the cutoffs; unit counts at the tiers. \emph{Unobserved.} Tenure for most projects. \emph{Confounds.} 158-17 fourteen months later. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{usable}.
\paragraph{Ord. 158-17 (inclusionary)} \textit{Ord. 158-17 (File 161351); effective 2017-08-26; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``following voter approval of Proposition Cat the June 7, 2016 election''.
\emph{Treated set.} As Prop C.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As Prop C. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} As Prop C. \emph{Unobserved.} As Prop C. \emph{Confounds.} The escalation keyed to the EEA date. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{usable}.
\paragraph{Ord. 201-23 (fee reductions)} \textit{Ord. 201-23 (File 230855); effective 2023-11-12; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``reduce Article 4 development impact fees, including lnclusionary Affordable Housing fees''.
\emph{Treated set.} Approval dates and first construction documents: the exaction panel.

\subsection{Category 4: option term and vesting}
\paragraph{SB 330 (Housing Crisis Act)} \textit{SB 330 (Skinner), Stats. 2019, ch. 654; effective 2020-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``SB 330, Skinner. Housing Crisis Act of 2019.'' --- ``more than five hearings pursuant to Section 65905''.
\emph{Treated set.} Housing projects; preliminary applications are flagged on PRJ records (the SB 330 field). SB 330 flag (PRJ): 27 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} (i) Preliminary applications by quarter; (ii) for housing cases, the share heard more than five times, before and after the operative date. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Filing timing relative to local rule changes. \emph{Unobserved.} Which hearings SB 330 counts; completeness dates. \emph{Confounds.} The pandemic (2020), the Housing Element cycle. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{usable}.
\paragraph{SB 8} \textit{SB 8 (Skinner), Stats. 2021, ch. 161; effective 2022-01-01 (inferred); opt-in: no; verified: yes.}

\emph{Treated set.} As SB 330.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} As SB 330. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} --- \emph{Unobserved.} As SB 330. \emph{Confounds.} An extension; no new variation. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{not measurable here}.
\paragraph{Ord. 193-23 (fee vesting and waivers)} \textit{Ord. 193-23 (File 230764); effective 2023-10-16; opt-in: no; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``provide that the type and rates of applicable development impact fees, with the exception of inclusionary housing fees, shall be determined at the time of project approval''.
\emph{Treated set.} Every project owing impact fees; the waiver districts are in the zoning panel.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} The vesting date of fees (the exaction panel). \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Timing of approvals and permits. \emph{Unobserved.} Which projects took the waiver. \emph{Confounds.} 201-23 a month later. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
\subsection{Category 5: feasible envelope}
\paragraph{Density Bonus Law} \textit{Gov. Code 65915; effective not established; opt-in: yes; verified: yes.}
\emph{What it changed.} In its own words: ``shall grant one density bonus, the amount of which shall be as specified in subdivision (f)''.
\emph{Treated set.} Projects that claim a bonus. The Planning records' density-bonus field is empty; claims are found by text, and the pipeline dataset flags current projects. density bonus in text: 58 a year, 2021--2025.
\emph{Mechanical first stage.} Bonus units granted; not recorded. \emph{Behavioural second stage.} Project size and affordable share. \emph{Unobserved.} The bonus, the concessions and waivers granted. \emph{Confounds.} HOME-SF, the local alternative, and AB 2345. \emph{Verdict:} \textbf{partially usable}.
